semiconductor_relevance: High — Withsystem Co., Ltd. specializes in semiconductor probe and test socket manufacturing, essential for semiconductor testing processes.
summary: Withsystem Co., Ltd. provides inspection solutions with a focus on semiconductor testing through its Semiconductor Business Division. The company manufactures key components such as probes and test sockets, offering customized designs and high-precision capabilities to meet diverse customer needs.
capabilities: Manufacturing of semiconductor probes and test sockets
Ultra-precision machining with hole drilling technology down to 0.1mm
Production capacity exceeding 2 million pins monthly
Support for various semiconductor package types including BGA, QFP, QFN, and LGA
